label: Active accounts
description: Accounts with a sign-in, report or other recorded activity in the trailing 30 days.

label: Search click-through rate
description: Search clicks divided by search impressions for the same saved daily rows. This is not a customer conversion rate.

label: First response
description: Median hours from a support request to the first human response. Lower is better.

label: Monthly recurring revenue
description: Invoice-backed recurring revenue for active paid subscriptions. The latest measured row, not an annualised estimate.

label: New accounts · 30d
description: Accounts created in the trailing 30 calendar days. This is a rolling count, not a daily signup count.

label: Reports · 30d
description: Completed reports in the trailing 30 calendar days. Deliberately sparse in the starter snapshot to demonstrate a real gap.

label: Reports generated
description: Cumulative completed reports. A counter may step down only after an explicit reset or correction.

label: 30-day retention
description: Accounts still active 30 days after their first report. Cohorts without a completed 30-day window are excluded.

label: Search impressions
description: Daily Google Search Console impressions for the property. Impressions are not visitors, accounts or customers.

label: Trial to paid · 30d
description: Mature trials that converted to a paid subscription within 30 days. Trials without a completed outcome window are excluded.
